RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; a defensible number cannot be inferred from these facts.

An all-women panel does not itself indicate sex bias. Your qualifications are strong, but a leadership appointment may also weigh management, regulatory expertise, and interview performance. The announcement is not her full CV.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate—not an explanation of the panel’s sex composition.

If evidence emerges of sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or unequal treatment, raise those specific concerns. Legal rights and complaint deadlines vary by jurisdiction; seek timely local advice if you’re considering a formal challenge.
